ctx.x: So one day I was going to rehearsal with Roy, and Bird Burt was there, and I asked him to come on and go to rehearsal with me. You know, so he went around, allegedly to sell some pot. He -- at this time Joe Eldridge was playing with Roy, Roy's brother. Very good saxophone player. And someone asked Bird Burt, they knew him, and asked him to play. And we never rehearsed. When Bird Burt got through blowing that was just it. I was the most amazed person in the world. I didn't know Bird played the saxophone. I knew…

Then he started going to Monroe's uptown house, and playing and he got to be known there. And then he worked with Jay McShan. But now I knew Dizzy -- this was before Dizzy, I mean this -- Dizzy was before Bird. In my, you know -- differently than anyone, MS. WILLARD: Dizzy played (inaudible). MR. COLLINS: Yes, yes.
